methods.name: list
methods.doc: Read the Loader directly on every call. Cordis's internal plugin/status events already maintain Entry.fiber and Fiber.state, so a second cache would only add another lifecycle truth to keep synchronized. When an agent-preset roster is composed, the snapshot also carries each preset's composition rows, because those rows — not the Loader's own entries — are where a deployment that mounts the roster runs its model-facing plugins.

props.name: id
props.doc: Stable preset id.

props.name: name
props.doc: Display name the preset published; a reader falls back to the id.

props.name: isDefault
props.doc: Whether a session naming no preset composes this one.

props.name: broken
props.doc: Why this preset's composition cannot be read; absent when rows answer.

props.name: rows
props.doc: Plugin rows in composition order; empty when the preset is broken.

AgentPresetPluginGroup.doc: One agent preset's identity and flattened composition in the inventory.

props.name: entryId
props.doc: Composition row id, or null when the row declares none.

props.name: moduleName
props.doc: Module specifier the row names.

props.name: meta
props.doc: Local package display metadata, independent of whether the preset is mounted.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Effective enablement, including disabled ancestor groups. `'conditional'` marks a `!!js` disabled expression on a composition no session has mounted, which only a Loader context can decide.

props.name: condition
props.doc: The row's own `!!js` disabled expression, when it carries one.

props.name: fiberPhase
props.doc: Root-fiber phase when the composition is live; null otherwise.

AgentPresetPluginRow.doc: One plugin row an agent preset's composition names.

LocalizedText.doc: Literal text or translations indexed by lowercase language id, with a required English fallback.

PluginFiberPhase.doc: Lifecycle state of an entry's root Fiber, or null when it has no live root Fiber.

props.name: moduleName
props.doc: Exact module specifier imported by the Loader entry.

props.name: meta
props.doc: Local package display metadata, independent of whether the entry is enabled.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Effective Loader enablement, including disabled ancestor groups.

PluginInventoryEntry.doc: One non-group Loader entry exposed to trusted clients.

props.name: managementAvailable
props.doc: Whether this Host exposes persistent current-profile management.

props.name: agentPresets
props.doc: Per-preset compositions, present only when an agent-preset roster is composed in this deployment.

PluginInventorySnapshot.doc: Point-in-time inventory returned by the plugin inventory Remote.

props.name: title
props.doc: Display title; omission preserves the consumer's technical-name fallback.

props.name: description
props.doc: Display introduction after locale and package-field fallback.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Base64 image data URL from a package root's manifest icon or an exported `<specifier>/icon`; render as an image, not inline markup.

props.name: error
props.doc: Unmodified local metadata diagnostic; the plugin remains manageable.

PluginLocalizedMeta.doc: Validated plugin display fields and diagnostics from exported locales, manifests, or icon files.

PresetPluginEnablement.doc: Effective enablement of one preset composition row.
